crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus.speaker: Marcellus

steps.speaker: Marcellus

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-talking.speaker: Marcellus
crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-talking.text: You didn't go near those frogs yet, did you?

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-talking.speaker: Marcellus
crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-talking.text: I can tell. If you had, you'd be dead!

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-talking.player: Okay then... Well assuming that I survive, I'll be back shortly to let you know what I've found.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Frog
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: Oh, hello there.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Frog
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: Well of course we can talk, silly. Why wouldn't we be able to?

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.player: Well I guess I'd just never considered it before...

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Frog
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: We live in a world where giant lizards with wings fly around and expel highly combustible fluids from their throats, but you never considered a frog could talk?

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.player: Well when you put it like that...

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Frog
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: Well now that we've established our remarkable linguistic capabilities, how about some introductions. I'm Sue and this is Gary. Over there you have Dave and Jane, and good old Mr Lonesome over there is Cuthbert.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.player: Pleased to meet you. I'm [player name].

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Sue
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: Well, [player name], what can we do for you?

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.player: Well there's a guy over there that thinks you're all evil.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Sue
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: Evil? We're not evil! We're just on strike.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Sue
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: We're on strike. Fair work requires fair treatment, and we've had enough of his nonsense.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.player: But... What do you do? What are you striking from?

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Sue
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: Oh... Well I can't really remember. It's been so long that I've gone and totally forgotten. Hey, Gary, why are we on strike?

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Gary
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: No idea. I've been on strike my whole life, just like my pa, and his pa before him. At this point it's kind of a family tradition.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Gary
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: I know it's because of him though. That monster spends every day mistreating us. If he ever wants to see any work from us, he needs to start showing some basic respect.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Sue
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: Too right, Gary, too right. What reason does he have for thinking we're evil anyway?

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Gary
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: Well he's one of them capitalists, isn't he. They see a worker demanding fair rights and they go loopy. Can't have anything getting in the way of their profit margins!

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.player: Actually, he never mentioned anything about work. He seems to think you're out to overthrow humanity.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Sue
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: Overthrow humanity? What a load of nonsense! We love humans! Gary here had one as a pet once.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Gary
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: Ah, those were the days. I always loved my Sentia. Such a shame about the accident...

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Sue
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: It wasn't your fault, Gary. It wasn't your fault. Anyway, if this chap thinks we're plotting to overthrow humanity, what's he planning to do about it?

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.player: I'm not too sure. He did mention at one point something about killing you all...

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Sue
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: He wants to what?!

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Gary
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: He wants to kill us?! Well now I think we should overthrow humanity!

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Sue
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: Yeah, we've been treated like second class citizens for too long. The revolution starts today!

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Sue
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: Peace? Interesting... I suppose peace could be fun. There would need to be some assurances though. Wouldn't want the guy going back on his word.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.player: Right... Well how about I go and ask him what conditions he'd be willing to accept.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.speaker: Sue
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs.text: Well that just sounds swell!

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs-ta.speaker: Sue
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs-ta.text: Hello again! Have you found out what peace conditions the grumpy guts has?

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs-ta.speaker: Sue
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs-ta.text: Well don't go taking too long.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs-ta.speaker: Cuthbert
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs-ta.text: I hear you're the one handling the peace talks. You will fail. There is no peace to be had with that man.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs-ta.player: Well I'd still like to give it a good go.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs-ta.speaker: Dave
crazy-frogs-talking-to-the-blue-frogs-ta.text: Hello there! You're the one sorting out the peace talks, right?

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.speaker: Marcellus
crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.text: The frogs didn't kill you? This is unexpected.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.player: Well I had a chat with them, and they're open to engaging in some peace talks.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.speaker: Marcellus
crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.text: Peace? The hypocrisy! After everything they've done they think peace is an option? Absolutely not!

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.player: Okay... But what exactly have they done that means peace isn't an option?

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.speaker: Marcellus
crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.text: Look, I can't remember. But they must have done something!

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.player: Yes I'm starting to think that's where the problem lies as well.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.speaker: Marcellus
crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.text: They must have taken my brain! That's why I can't remember! You tell them I want my brain back!

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.player: So you'd be willing to negotiate peace in exchange for your... brain?

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.speaker: Marcellus
crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.text: Negotiate? I don't negotiate with monsters!

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.player: I don't think they're monsters. They actually seem somewhat friendly.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.speaker: Marcellus
crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.text: Well do they have a leader?

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.speaker: Marcellus
crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.text: Well you go tell them that I'll only negotiate with their leader.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.player: Every day I find myself further questioning my life choices. Fine. I'll go and ask them about their leader.

crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.speaker: Marcellus
crazy-frogs-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.text: I'm only going to negotiate with the leader of those monsters. You go tell them that!

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Hello again! Have you found out what peace conditions the grumpy guts has?

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.player: Sort of. He seems open to the idea of peace talks, but he will only negotiate with your leader. Do you have a leader?

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Oh, well not really.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Gary
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Nah, we're more about collective leadership. We did consider starting a union at one point, but Dave messed up the paperwork.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.player: Well would you be interested in having a leader?

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: A change to our political structure? That's quite the thing to undergo.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Gary
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Yeah, especially in times of war. Still, maybe we need to mix things up. We've been saying for a while now that we've been stagnating. Perhaps this is just the thing we need.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: There would need to be an election of course.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.player: Do you have a process for that sort of thing?

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Absolutely! We use a first past the post system where everyone votes based on a candidate's hopping capabilities.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Oh it's all very simple. The candidates perform their finest hop and everyone else votes on which they thought was best. The one with the most votes wins!

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.player: I see. Well, I don't, but for the sake of my sanity, let's say I do. Shall we call an election then?

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Sounds like a wonderful idea! There is just the small matter of Cuthbert...

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: That's right. You see, while you were gone, we told the others about this whole killing us all business. Now, I must admit, emotions did run a bit high, especially for Cuthbert.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Once he learns about the election, he will almost definitely want to put himself forward, and I'm afraid he has little interest in peace.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Gary
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: I mean, can you blame the guy? Cuthbert was once the leader of the Frogs for Humanity society. The guy loved humans, but after what they did to his favourite plant...

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Some wounds never heal...

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.player: So you're saying Cuthbert can't win the election?

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: The idea of rigging an election is one that fills my democracy-loving heart with terror, but yes, we will need to do that.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Gary
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: It's okay if we're the ones to do it, right?

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Not in the slightest, but I do love that positive attitude. Besides, the alternative is all-out war with humanity.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.player: Which we very much need to avoid! So how do we ensure Cuthbert can't win the election?

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: The hop-off will see the candidates hop from the shore to a lily pad. Now, if Cuthbert's lily pad had an unfortunate hole in it...

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.player: Okay... I guess I'm off to sabotage a lily pad.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Just be careful of Dave and Jane. They're sticklers for the rules, I'm afraid. You can't let them see you.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Hello again! How are things going with that lily pad sabotage?

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Just be careful of Dave and Jane. They're sticklers for the rules, I'm afraid. You can't let them see you.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-cuthbert.speaker: Cuthbert
democracy-at-work-talking-to-cuthbert.text: It seems we are to have an election. Know that once I win, our war with humanity will be unlike anything ever seen.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-cuthbert.speaker: Cuthbert
democracy-at-work-talking-to-cuthbert.text: You should go. Go and be with your loved ones. Hold them close while you can. Soon you will never have that luxury again.

democracy-at-work-attempting-to-sabotage.speaker: Jane
democracy-at-work-attempting-to-sabotage.text: Hey, don't be going near those lily pads. We've got them all set up ready for the hop-off.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.speaker: Dave
democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.text: Hello there! Have you heard about the election? Isn't it thrilling?

democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.player: That is definitely a word that could be used to describe this situation. Anyway, speaking of the election, I need to inspect the lily pads.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.speaker: Jane
democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.text: No can do. We've got them all set up nicely. Can't be letting anyone mess things up, can we?

democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.player: Of course not, but don't you think it would be wise for a third party just to give them a quick once over? Besides, the two of you deserve a break.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.speaker: Dave
democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.text: Well I really could do with a bit of a rest, not to mention the fact that I'm starving. Still, the lily pads are our duty. It would be wrong of us to let someone else touch them.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.player: Hmm... You said you were hungry? Out of interest, what would you fancy? For when the election is out of the way, of course.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.speaker: Jane
democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.text: Oh I'd kill for a nice tasty orange!

democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.player: An orange? I didn't know frogs ate oranges...

democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.speaker: Dave
democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.text: Yeah most people think we just eat flies. We do, and we love them, but sometimes you find that you've just had enough flies and fancy something more exotic.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.player: Where do you get your oranges?

democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.speaker: Jane
democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.text: They grow on trees around here, like this one right next to us. From time to time an orange will fall off, but the really good ones are the ones at the top.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.speaker: Dave
democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.text: Just a shame we can't reach those ones...

democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.player: Remind me, where do you get your oranges?

democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.speaker: Jane
democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.text: They grow on trees around here, like this one right next to us. From time to time an orange will fall off, but the really good ones are the ones at the top.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.speaker: Dave
democracy-at-work-talking-to-dave-or-jan.text: Just a shame we can't reach those ones...

democracy-at-work-after-chopping-down-th.speaker: Dave
democracy-at-work-after-chopping-down-th.text: Can't stop to talk! There's oranges to be had!

democracy-at-work-sabotaging-the-lily-pa.text: You pick up a small stone from the shore and throw it at the lily pad. It leaves a barely noticeable hole in it.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Hello again! How are things going with that lily pad sabotage?

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: And just in time as well. The hop-off is about to begin.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Gary
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Sue of course!

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Don't worry. Once I win, I'll make sure these peace talks go nice and smoothly.

democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
democracy-at-work-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Let's!

democracy-at-work-watching-the-frog-hop-.text: A cutscene starts. All the frogs and capybara gather by the water.

democracy-at-work-watching-the-frog-hop-.speaker: Gary
democracy-at-work-watching-the-frog-hop-.text: Welcome, one and all, to what is bound to be a thrilling frog hop-off! The stakes are high for this one, and indeed the future of our entire world may well be at stake.

democracy-at-work-watching-the-frog-hop-.speaker: Gary
democracy-at-work-watching-the-frog-hop-.text: Our first contender for today is Sue! Let's see what she's got!
Sue hops onto the lily pad.

democracy-at-work-watching-the-frog-hop-.speaker: Gary
democracy-at-work-watching-the-frog-hop-.text: What a corker of a hop! Excellent work!
Cuthbert hops onto the lily pad, but sinks into the water. A brief pause ensues.

democracy-at-work-watching-the-frog-hop-.speaker: Gary
democracy-at-work-watching-the-frog-hop-.text: Yeah, totally slipped my mind, but he never learnt how to swim!

democracy-at-work-watching-the-frog-hop-.player: A frog that never learnt to swim? Are you serious right now?!

democracy-at-work-watching-the-frog-hop-.speaker: Gary
democracy-at-work-watching-the-frog-hop-.text: Afraid so! Cuthbert is now as dead as an Old One. With only one contender left standing, I can now announce that Sue is the winner!

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Well now that's all sorted, we can get these peace talks underway!

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.player: I can't believe we killed him...

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Gary
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Ah, don't worry yourself. Something like this was bound to happen at some point. It's his fault really. Imagine never learning to swim!

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Exactly! So what does our foe want?

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.player: He thinks you've stolen his brain and would like it back.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Gary
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: His brain? But we don't have his brain...

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.player: Well is there anything else you can offer him?

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Gary
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: It's not like we really do much. We're frogs. All we do is eat flies, along with the odd orange.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.player: Well maybe we can still work with that. I'm sure our friend doesn't like flies. Maybe you could deal with the flies around here for him?

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Sounds like a job for us! Though we'd of course need something in return.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Fair pay for fair work, of course. If not, we'll go on strike! We're good at going on strike.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.player: And how would you like to be paid?

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Sue
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Well normally I'd say in flies, but it seems we've got that covered.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.speaker: Gary
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.text: Oh, and orange juice as well! Straight from the tap!

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue.player: From the tap? But orange juice doesn't...
Actually, never mind. Let's not complicate things further. I'll take these terms to him and see what he says.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-talki.speaker: Gary
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-talki.text: Hello! How go the peace talks?

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-talki.speaker: Sue
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-talki.text: Remember, we kill flies, we get oranges. That's the deal.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-talki.speaker: Dave
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-talki.text: Can you believe Cuthbert died? Such a shame.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-talki.speaker: Jane
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-talki.text: Sue will be a great leader though. I can't wait to see what she does first!

peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.speaker: Marcellus
peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.text: Have you found the leader of those frogs? I'm only going to negotiate with the leader!

peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.player: Yes, the frogs have selected a leader and she has sent me with her terms.
The frogs will kill the flies around the oasis and in return they'd like you to pay them in oranges.

peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.speaker: Marcellus
peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.text: Flies? But what have the flies done wrong?

peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.player: Well don't they spread disease and eat your food?

peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.speaker: Marcellus
peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.text: Yes, but so did my brother, and I never wanted him dead. What else have the flies been doing?

peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.player: I don't know! You seemed convinced the frogs were out to get you before, maybe the flies are as well!

peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.speaker: Marcellus
peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.text: The flies are out to get me? Is it really true?

peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.player: You know what, sure. The flies want you dead and they plan to do it tonight.
So are you willing to make this deal with the frogs?

peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.speaker: Marcellus
peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.text: Not yet. First I must see proof of this horrific betrayal by the flies. Find this proof for me, and I will agree to the deal.

peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.player: Maybe my whole life is just one big nightmare. Fine, I'll find this proof.

peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.speaker: Marcellus
peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.text: You're back. Do you have the proof?

peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.speaker: Marcellus
peace-talks-talking-to-marcellus-after-t.text: Then return to me once you have it.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-2.speaker: Sue
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-2.text: Hello! How go the peace talks?

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-2.player: He's open to the proposals, but he wants proof that the flies are against him.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-2.speaker: Gary
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-2.text: He doesn't half complain, does he? Maybe it would have just been easier to kill him...

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-2.speaker: Sue
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-2.text: How about you steal a prized possession of his and plant it on the flies.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-2.player: Oh good, now we're adding theft to today's crimes.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-2.speaker: Gary
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-2.text: Well it could be worse. It could be murder!

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-2.speaker: Gary
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-2.text: Nah, that wasn't murder! Manslaughter at best! Or would that be frogslaughter...

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-2.speaker: Sue
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-2.text: It had to be done. Now, why don't you go and find something to steal.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-talki.speaker: Sue
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-talki.text: Hello! Did you find something to steal?

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-talki.speaker: Gary
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-talki.text: Keep looking. I'm sure you'll find something suitable.

peace-talks-searching-marcellus-bed.text: If the player is already holding the love letter:

steps.text: You search the bed, but find nothing of interest.

peace-talks-searching-marcellus-bed.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You search the bed and find a love letter, but you don't have enough room to take it.

peace-talks-searching-marcellus-bed.text: You search the bed and find a love letter.

peace-talks-unlocking-marcellus-chest.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You unlock the chest and find a plushy inside, but you don't have enough room to take it.

peace-talks-unlocking-marcellus-chest.text: You unlock the chest and find a plushy inside.

peace-talks-opening-the-chest-after-unlo.text: If the player already has the plushy:

steps.text: You already have the plushy from this chest.

peace-talks-opening-the-chest-after-unlo.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You open the chest and find a plushy inside, but you don't have enough room to take it.

peace-talks-opening-the-chest-after-unlo.text: You open the chest and find a plushy inside.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-with-.speaker: Sue
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-with-.text: Hello! Did you find something to steal?

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-with-.player: Yes, I have a plushy here of his.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-with-.speaker: Gary
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-with-.text: Perfect! Shove it in that big pile of dung the flies keep gathering around and then go and let him know.

peace-talks-planting-without-evidence.text: You don't have anything suitable to plant here.

peace-talks-attempting-to-plant-the-lett.text: While the letter has potential, you feel like you need something even better to plant here.

peace-talks-planting-the-plushy.text: You place the plushy right in the middle of the dung.

peace-talks-planting-the-plushy.speaker: Cuthbert, Lord of Dread
peace-talks-planting-the-plushy.text: You! Prepare to face the Lord of Dread!

peace-talks-opening-the-chest-after-plan.text: You search the chest, but find nothing of interest.

peace-talks-talking-to-dave-jane-or-marc.text: You should first deal with Cuthbert, Lord of Dread.

peace-talks-cuthbert-killing-the-player.speaker: Cuthbert
peace-talks-cuthbert-killing-the-player.text: I have come for you, [player name].

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-befor.speaker: Sue
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-befor.text: Hello! How goes the planting of evidence?

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-befor.player: It's all done, but I do now have a little problem to deal with. I'll be back.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-after.speaker: Sue
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-after.text: Hello! How goes the planting of evidence?

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-after.speaker: Gary
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-after.text: Well what are you waiting for? Time to go and let him know!

peace-talks-telling-marcellus-of-the-evi.speaker: Marcellus
peace-talks-telling-marcellus-of-the-evi.text: You're back. Do you have the proof?

peace-talks-telling-marcellus-of-the-evi.player: I think I do. You see that big pile of dung the flies are gathered around? I'm sure I saw something belonging to you in it.

peace-talks-telling-marcellus-of-the-evi.speaker: Marcellus
peace-talks-telling-marcellus-of-the-evi.text: It cannot be?! Wait here! I must check at once!
The screen briefly fades to black.
Marcellus goes to check on the dung...

peace-talks-telling-marcellus-of-the-evi.speaker: Marcellus
peace-talks-telling-marcellus-of-the-evi.text: I see my worst fears have come to pass. This is dark day not just for me, but for all of humanity.

peace-talks-telling-marcellus-of-the-evi.speaker: Marcellus
peace-talks-telling-marcellus-of-the-evi.text: Return to the frogs. Tell them we have a deal.

peace-talks-telling-marcellus-of-the-evi.speaker: Marcellus
peace-talks-telling-marcellus-of-the-evi.text: Leave me. I need time to contemplate this great loss. Return to the frogs. Tell them we have a deal.

peace-talks-talking-to-dave-or-jane.speaker: Dave
peace-talks-talking-to-dave-or-jane.text: I hear the peace talks are going well. We might be close to ending the conflict with that nasty human.

peace-talks-talking-to-dave-or-jane.speaker: Jane
peace-talks-talking-to-dave-or-jane.text: I do hope so. This war is starting to take a toll on all of us. We had to start rationing the oranges!

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-after.player: I have good news! The terms have been accepted.
Oh, and it turns out Cuthbert was still alive after all.
Er... no. He's now properly dead.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-after.speaker: Sue
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-after.text: War always has casualties. We will forever remember Cuthbert's sacrifice.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-after.speaker: Gary
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-after.text: Well said! Today will be a day remembered by all of frog-kind, and much of it is thanks to you, [player name].

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-after.player: Thanks. I only wish I had the ability to scrub the memories of all this from my brain, but as I can't, I guess I now have to carry them forever.

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-after.speaker: Gary
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-after.text: Have you tried soap and water?

peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-after.speaker: Sue
peace-talks-talking-to-gary-or-sue-after.text: Oh don't be so negative. You've done a good thing, [player name]! Now go. Go with the blessing of the frogs, and know that you really are a true hero!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-marcellus.speaker: Marcellus
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-marcellus.text: Hello again. You helped forge my alliance with the frogs against those disgusting flies. Please feel free to use my farming patch in return. It's the least I can do.

options.text: Would you look after my crops for me?
Can you give me any farming advice?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-gary-or-s.player: Hello again. How are things going?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-gary-or-s.speaker: Gary
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-gary-or-s.text: Amazing! We get paid to eat all day, and our payment is more food. Life has never been better!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-gary-or-s.speaker: Sue
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-gary-or-s.text: Too right, Gary! This is much better than being on strike!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-dave-or-j.speaker: Dave
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-dave-or-j.text: Today is a good day to be a frog!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-dave-or-j.speaker: Jane
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-dave-or-j.text: It sure is. Now that we have peace, life is at an all time high!
